headline.note: Family-business management dates are recorded but hours, leave, payroll basis and substantive full-time status remain unknown. LGP Associate Director is now resolved as excluded board governance. Other elected, party, association, advisory and study spells remain excluded. No supported full-time interval can yet be calculated; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Laxale's Hair & Beauty Supplies Pty Ltd
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the employer, combined titles and November 2004 to November 2017 boundaries. The secondary biography identifies it as the family hair-and-beauty supplies business. Ownership, remuneration, hours, leave and title transitions are unresolved, including overlap with party and elected roles. Follow-up: matching ABR entity identifies legal name and ABN 74 098 599 065; its 2001 registration is not the member’s employment commencement. Historical shareholding, actual hours and division between management work and directorship remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title in a family business does not prove self-employment or substantive full-time work.

career_spells.role: Non-Executive Director and Risk Committee Chair
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen extract supplies the non-executive directorship and month boundaries; the secondary biography adds Risk Committee chair. StateCover describes itself as a mutual owned by its member councils. Remuneration and meeting load are unresolved, and non-executive governance is not treated as substantive employment. LGNSW report refines initial appointment to 10 September 2018, with reappointment 20 November 2019. Council ownership and nomination arrangements do not alone resolve the codebook’s ultimate-control test; prior private-control coding is therefore withheld. Scheduled November 2022 term is not used to replace recorded June 2022 departure.
career_spells.counting_note: Board governance is displayed separately and excluded from the narrow public/private employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the organisation, office and month boundaries. The secondary biography describes the role as a directorship/treasurer office. Hours and any separate employment relationship remain unresolved. Officer disclosure establishes $14,053.23 including superannuation as treasurer and $66,338.04 for external boards in 2020/21. External-board amount is not allocated to particular boards. Remuneration establishes paid governance, not full-time employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Employer-association governance is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen extract records November 2020–June 2022. LGP’s 2021 annual report identifies Associate Director as a board appointment linking LGP to owner LGNSW, resolving the earlier uncertainty about whether this was an operational job. Its biography gives October 2020 commencement; the one-month disagreement is retained for reconciliation, without changing the frozen boundary. Pay allocation, meeting load and ultimate government control remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Board governance is excluded; neither the title nor aggregated external-board remuneration supports full-time employment.

open_questions: What were actual family-business hours, leave, pay basis and management/directorship transitions during November 2004–November 2017, including overlap with council office?
Can appointment instruments reconcile LGP October versus November 2020 commencement and independently confirm its June 2022 end?
What were the historical ownership/control arrangements of StateCover, and which external boards account for disclosed aggregate remuneration?
Are earlier jobs or later business-consulting clients omitted from official occupations, and what are their dates and hours?
Can primary records refine Venture Café, party and local-government chronology and paid/unpaid conditions?
Which parliamentary office hosted the ANU internship, when, and with what remuneration, hours and study-credit arrangements?
research_notes: 2026-10-01 follow-up: official register resolves matching family company; historical LGP report reclassifies Associate Director as excluded governance, and LGNSW report refines StateCover appointment and establishes paid treasurer governance. No salary-to-hours conversion or external-board pay allocation made.

Searched family company, LGP historical annual reports, StateCover and LGNSW filings, first speech and declarations. LGP 2022 report corroborates board context; 2021/22 LGNSW website PDF failed retrieval, but 2020/21 FWC-hosted report was readable. Member speech page timed out; public Hansard reproduction describes parents’ long hours, not a dated work pattern for the member. Later StateCover membership resignation is not treated as his directorship cessation. No evidence of a calculable full-time family-business interval found.
Second follow-up2October2026 improves education and placement chronology; totals remain unknown.

Targeted family-business full-time searches yielded staff vacancies rather than personal hours, which were rejected. Council26June2018 agenda, printed pp49–50, reproduces Venture Cafe innovation partnership resolution but does not appoint Laxale personally to its board. PDF exceeded web-reader size limit; ordinary direct download and text extraction succeeded. Partnership funding/trial dates do not establish personal governance term. Next leads remain family payroll/hours, personal Venture Cafe appointment, internship host and original LGP appointment instruments.
